Love God, and obey with all your heart. Because faith without works is dead, and works without faith is dead. You need to have both, to make perfect like Abraham. And too many people live in sin, and think they can be right with God. That’s not true because there is no true obedience which is love for Him. But also don’t partially obey because that is the same as not obeying, so give your life to Christ! So don’t blame God for your bad times, but pray and trust Him just like job did. Roman’s 8:18, “the pain we feel now, will never compare to the glory we will feel after” So trust Gods plan and never forget about Him because to many times we get caught up in our own struggles and worries, but give it to Jesus, He will take care of it, all you gotta do really is just trust God forever in every way possible. No, but what saved us and what saved us is first His sacrifice and if we have faith. And don’t get me wrong, works are so important, you need to have both. So don’t just live under the Commandments when you follow God, but realize He is the One that fulfilled it. But God did this so we can feel guilty and humble ourselves. And through this we can to the Man that fulfilled it through Faith. So have both faith and works but remember faith is the more important one. So don’t use this as an excuse to not do works for God. God knows your intentions! When we overcome sin, we tend to take credit. We say thanks Lord that I obeyed. Remember, you did, but take out that I, make it Him. Be fully dependent and thankful towards Him because sometimes God lets us overcome sin to show us how weak we are. Because we celebrate ourselves instead of Him. So have faith, faith is the only thing that pleases Him, but with genuine faith, comes genuine works. Works don’t save, faith does. So trust God, don’t take control, but give the control to the One that knows how to control. So knowing the truth doesn’t save you. Faith plus obedience does. Control tends to be looked at as disciple. We gotta boast about our weaknesses because those weaknesses gives us strength in the One that is the Greatest, and is the Judge of all. Don’t fear humans that can only hurt the body, but fear God, for He seeks all so obey Him. We think it is 50/50 with God, it’s not, it’s 0/100, He takes full control, don’t try to, but also, work for God. Because having true faith leads you to know that we can’t just sit down and not change and do something for God because He is so great! Word over emotions, Relationship over religion, and Jesus over moral values for the Word of God is sharper than any 2 edged sword (Hebrew 4:11-14) and it can divide the flesh to the Spirit, your emotions over truth. True repentance is more than a cycle of "sorry"; it is a fundamental shift in your heart, mind, and life toward Christ. Instead of staying stuck in a loop of guilt—which can treat Jesus’ sacrifice as unfinished because you just say sorry, like if Jesus didn’t say “it is finished”!—true repentance acknowledges that we are inherently unrighteous without Him.Consider King David: when he fell, his confession wasn't just about his specific actions of adultery and murder, but an admission of his total need for God. He didn't dwell on the "forgiveness cycle"; he acknowledged his nature, accepted God's grace, and changed his direction. Amen? So just know, confession to God leads to good repentance since confession is acknowledging you are worthy of death and a sinner, but with God, you are made with a purpose and are turned into a righteous person through Him, so a better form of sorry is acknowledging and thanking.

Be careful, it might not seem like much harm. Don’t be a slave to sin, but God there is no in between.

He paid it all, so all sins are cleared, don’t use this as an excuse to do what you do best and sin, but change that “best” into God by obeying and having faith with works that come along. Like a big package. Have true faith, works come with it. So remember, we are made of dirt, of the lowest, and we need the Word of God/ Jesus as our seed to grow and produce true life. And with this, it doesn’t make much sense, but it encourages other soil to plant that seed of yours and produce life itself! So basically, when you have true faith in God, you produce life, the seed. The Word of God/Jesus. And with this comes natural willful preaching that leads other soil to have that seed planted by you, and God will grow it. Not you growing it and sprouting it. Remember, leave the milk, leave the easy things, the reason why you wanna change so bad is because you are growing for God! You are growing into that solid food because you are now becoming grown in Christ. So don’t compare, that’s why you might fall so much. Comparing isn’t of God, it causes to be someone we aren’t, it’s good to have inspiration, but to compare leads to endless desire to be perfect. No, you are not, but through God you are made righteous and leave your old ways of milk for infants, to solid food, big grown people stuff you know? So obey God, but most importantly don’t take control and let God take it. Seek change but don’t think it is works that pleases God. Righteous works don’t produce faith, but righteous faith produces works for God. Having boundaries and seeking disciple for God. For God disciples the ones He loves. So don’t be ignorant, no, but listen and obey what God is telling you. For it is not to irate you or get you mad, but to help you closer to Him because He knows. This tells you you’re His child, because He is making you His, and not keeping you the same. You want change, but have no trust in God! You wanna change, but you put no effort into it with no boundaries! Hearing Gods word and not disciplining  yourself in Him (obeying) then you are deceiving yourself. It’s not works that save you, but they are surely important! But remember it is faith, then works come along. You want maturity, but don’t work for it. Trust God always, but also make a difference. You obey because it is a rule, but because it’s that you are now in a relationship with Him seeking that change. There is no condemnation for He is extremely patient, but He does call you to continue growing in Him and relationship with Him. So leave the basics and go on into maturity. And it is actually good to review the basics again, but don’t stay stuck living in them. So don’t just be curious about God! But pick your cross up and follow Him!
